controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.text: (paraphrase) Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including key management, are defined and implemented.

controls.title: Information transfer
controls.text: (paraphrase) Transfer rules, procedures, and controls protect information in transit across all transfer facilities.

controls.title: Logging
controls.text: (paraphrase) Logs of activities, exceptions, faults, and relevant events are produced, stored, protected, and analysed.

controls.title: Secure development life cycle
controls.text: (paraphrase) Rules for the secure development of software and systems are established and applied.

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.text: (paraphrase) Secure coding principles are applied throughout software development.
